notes: POST accepts only clientId/currency/dueDate/issuedDate/number; note and subject are silently dropped — create the draft first, then set them via updateInvoice.
Invoice money fields are minor units (cents) on the wire; no currency scaling applied by transport.
Invoice item unitPrice is minor units x100 (hundredths of a cent); amount = unitPrice * quantity / 100.
Binary invoice export; SDK-only read — no context-safe raw MCP representation in v1.
userLocale query parameter is required by live Clockify; default en-US.
Non-mutating POST — a read that carries its filter in a JSON body.
GET on a deleted or never-existing invoice id returns 400 code 501 (Invoice doesn't belong to Workspace), never 404.
Last-Page response header is authoritative for pagination.
PUT replaces the whole document — a sparse body drops every omitted field (note, subject, billFrom, clientAddress, ...). Runtime GET-then-PUT preservation is required.

Asymmetric tax/discount: GET returns discount/tax/tax2 as x100-scaled values (10% -> 1000), but the PUT body wants discountPercent/taxPercent/tax2Percent as plain percents. Copying GET names verbatim silently zeroes tax/discount.
Invoice money fields are minor units (cents); item unitPrice is minor x100.
